Title: E-ink
description of idea: Small screen displaying general questions about the visitor's art experience. three buttons
description of interaction: Visitor presses next, back or random button.
goal: make visitors think about their experience
space needed: depends on the size of the screen
accessibility: Text only: needs reading. Mount screen and buttons at wheelchair height; large font.

Title: Postcards
description of interaction: Visitor picks them up and reads them.
goal: make visitors think about their experience
accessibility: Text only: needs reading. Large print; holder within reach from a wheelchair.

Title: "Am I the only one?" counter
description of idea: Screen next to a work showing one real visitor question and a button "I wondered this too"; a counter shows how many pressed it.
description of interaction: Visitor reads the question and presses the button if they share it.
goal: show visitors they are not alone with their questions; show the museum which questions are common
space needed: about 30 × 30 cm of wall or pedestal next to the work
accessibility: Text only: needs reading. Button at wheelchair height, tactile.

Title: Second label
description of idea: Extra label next to the wall text with the most-asked visitor question about this work and a short answer, updated regularly.
description of interaction: Visitor reads it next to the work.
goal: answer recurring questions where they arise
equipment needed: printed labels and holders (or small e-ink label)
space needed: next to the existing wall text
accessibility: Plain language; large print; easy-language version possible.

Title: Question wall over time
description of idea: Wall where visitors post their questions, sorted by date, next to questions from earlier years and other generations.
description of interaction: Visitor writes a question on a sticky note, puts it on the wall and reads the others.
goal: connect visitors across time and generations; collect questions
accessibility: Writing needed: allow drawings; pens and notes at several heights.

Title: Talking hour
description of idea: Fixed time slot when talking in the gallery is welcome; a mediator moderates a conversation that starts from visitor questions.
description of interaction: Visitor joins the group, listens and shares their view.
goal: conversation among visitors; museum as moderator, not teacher
target group: adults, regular visitors, seniors, local community
equipment needed: stools, sign with the time, question cards
accessibility: Spoken: state the language; seats available; hearing loop to check.

Title: The museum asks back
description of idea: The museum puts one open question next to a work (e.g. "What would you title this?"); some answers are shown nearby.
description of interaction: Visitor reads the question and writes an answer on a card or via QR code.
goal: turn explanation into conversation; learn how visitors read the works
equipment needed: printed question, answer cards, box, pens or QR code
space needed: next to the work, small surface for the box
accessibility: Written: offer QR and card; large print.

Title: Mediator logbook
description of idea: Mediators and guards note the questions visitors ask them during the day.
description of interaction: Visitor asks a mediator; the mediator records the question (no personal data).
goal: capture questions that are asked but stay invisible
target group: internal: mediators, curators; visitors who talk to staff
equipment needed: notebook or tablet with a short form
accessibility: Works in any language the mediator speaks; no reading needed for the visitor.

Title: Exit question (QR)
description of idea: At the exit one question is shown: "What did you still want to know?"
description of interaction: Visitor scans a QR code and answers on their phone; results can appear on a screen.
goal: show the museum what was missing
equipment needed: QR sign, online form or Mentimeter, optional screen
space needed: exit area, wall for the sign
accessibility: Needs a smartphone: offer a paper card as alternative.

Title: Digital feedback station
description of idea: Touchscreen where visitors type a question and read questions others left about the same room.
description of interaction: Visitor types a question and browses others.
goal: low-threshold digital way to ask; see others' questions
equipment needed: touchscreen or tablet on a stand, network
accessibility: Screen at adjustable or seated height; large font; several languages.

Title: Audio guide question track
description of idea: Extra track per work in the audio guide: real visitor questions read aloud, with a short answer or another visitor's view.
description of interaction: Visitor chooses the question track in the audio guide.
goal: bring visitors' voices and questions into the visit
accessibility: Good for visually impaired visitors; add a text transcript for deaf visitors.

Title: Question-led guided tour
description of idea: Guided tour built around the most frequent visitor questions instead of a fixed script.
description of interaction: Visitors name their questions at the start; the guide builds the route around them.
goal: answer what visitors actually want to know
accessibility: Spoken: state the language; step-free route and seats to check.

Title: Question workshop
description of idea: Workshop where participants learn to look closely and formulate questions about artworks.
description of interaction: Participants look, write and exchange questions in small groups.
goal: value questions as knowledge; build confidence in front of art
accessibility: Adaptable: drawing or speaking instead of writing.

Title: Visitor meetups
description of idea: The museum announces meetups on Meetup or Spontacts around a question from the archive.
description of interaction: Visitors sign up online, meet in the museum and visit together.
goal: connect visitors who share a curiosity
target group: young adults, newcomers, people visiting alone
accessibility: Online sign-up needed; meeting point step-free.

Title: Social media video answers
description of idea: Short videos in which mediators, artists or visitors answer one visitor question each.
description of interaction: Visitor watches the video on a screen or via QR code next to the work.
goal: answers in a familiar format, also online
equipment needed: smartphone or camera, screen or QR sign
space needed: small screen or sign next to the work
accessibility: Subtitles needed; audio description to check.

Title: FAQ booklet / page
description of idea: The most frequent questions per exhibition and their answers, in a booklet and on the website.
description of interaction: Visitor reads it before or during the visit.

Title: Online question archive
description of idea: Searchable archive of all collected questions, by work, date and type.
description of interaction: Visitor or curator searches and reads questions online.
goal: make visitors' questions lasting, shared knowledge

Title: Curator AI assistant
description of idea: Platform where curators describe their exhibition and get a prompt for reflection and new interventions.
description of interaction: Curator fills in a form, copies the prompt into an AI assistant.
goal: help curators choose and plan their own interventions
accessibility: Prompt can ask for answers in DE, FR, EN, IT.
